name: Commission Form
summary: Commission-intake composition over canonical fields, optional reference upload, and actions without prescribing the record or submission workflow.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Commission-intake composition root emitted only with required field content; a standalone Web target uses a native form while an embedded target avoids nested forms.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional introduction region omitted when both title and guidance are empty.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual heading that may name a standalone form.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Optional concise target-authored guidance presented before affected controls.

anatomy.name: fields
anatomy.description: Required non-empty logical composition of canonical named controls.

anatomy.name: referenceUpload
anatomy.description: Optional layout region containing one canonical File Upload; R8 does not recreate FileList or upload state.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Button composition with explicit truthful native action types.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One neutral commission-intake composition; fields and workflow own their own variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Bounded form measure and action layout respond to actual available inline size.

states.name: default
states.description: R8 has no parallel validation or submission state; composed dependencies and the target workflow retain state ownership.

behavior.name: strictRequiredComposition
behavior.description: A missing or empty required fields slot omits the complete R8 root; optional title, intro, reference upload, and actions never create an empty form shell.

behavior.name: formBoundary
behavior.description: A standalone Web target preserves native form ownership. A target embedding R8 in another form uses a neutral container and retains the outer form as the sole owner.

behavior.name: fieldComposition
behavior.description: Canonical Input and Textarea own visible labels, value, type, name, autocomplete, required/disabled behavior, descriptions, focus, and Default, Error, Success, and Warning validation.

behavior.name: uploadComposition
behavior.description: Canonical File Upload owns one native FileList, visible instruction/hint/status, accept guidance, selection, reset, disabled, focus, drag-presence enhancement, and validation presentation. R8 owns no transport or file policy.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: Canonical Buttons preserve submit, reset, cancel, disabled, and busy semantics selected by the target; R8 adds no action state.

behavior.name: workflowOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own field inventory, consent/privacy, domain validation, encoding/endpoint, persistence, pending/error/success timing, result announcement/focus, notifications, abuse protection, and every later commission stage.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: Measure, wrapping, and action stacking respond to R8's actual inline size without changing reading, source, or tab order.

properties.name: intro
properties.description: Optional concise target-provided guidance shown before the controls.

properties.name: fields
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned canonical Input, Textarea, or other approved control composition in logical order.

properties.name: referenceUpload
properties.description: Optional canonical File Upload composition; accepted files, validation, transport, storage, and deletion remain target owned.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional target-owned canonical Button actions with explicit native types.

accessibility: Use a native standalone form on Web or a non-form host when embedded; never nest form elements.
Associate every composed control with a visible label and present required status, formats, limits, and instructions before they are needed.
Give submitted controls stable unique names and preserve the activated submitter, native FormData, constraint validation, and reset behavior unless the target owns a complete accessible replacement.
Keep source, visual, reading, and keyboard order aligned; responsive action stacking must not reorder controls or actions.
Compose canonical Input and Textarea validation and descriptions; do not duplicate aria-invalid, messages, state classes, or focus behavior on R8.
Compose one canonical File Upload as the only FileList owner. Treat accept as a picker hint, visibly disclose target policy, and validate files in the receiving service.
Use explicit submit, reset, and non-submit Button types. Pending/disabled policy and duplicate-submission prevention remain target owned.
Provide concise target-owned success/error feedback. Longer multi-error forms should expose a useful summary and target-approved announcement/focus behavior without erasing valid entries.
Preserve full text, native zoom, user spacing, RTL, forced colors, reduced motion, and dependency focus/keyboard behavior.

web.notes: Standalone native form or non-nested host composition with canonical fields/upload/actions, intrinsic logical layout, and no R8 neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Requires approved commission fields, consent, contact or app endpoint, Liquid form mapping, result behavior, and a verified file-upload service if references are required.

webflow.notes: The target chooses its form and file service while retaining canonical names, labels, validation, and response semantics.
